notes.title: 🎨 Dreampainters - The Journey Begins!
notes.content:
[h3]🖐️ Hello there![/h3]

My name is Xibuk, former House Flipper 2 game director and I'd like to tell you about my new project, [b]Dreampainters[/b]. 
We are a small, passionate team strongly inspired by games such as [b]Portal[/b], [b]Superliminal[/b], and [b]Viewfinder[/b]. Dreaming is a fascinating process, some people remember their fantasy while others only wish for it. We aim to create a title that immerses you in an amazing surrealistic world of dreams.

So what is [b]Dreampainters[/b] about? [b]It's a first-person game, where you travel through your dreams trying to solve puzzles using paints of different colors and abilities.[/b]



[h3]😉 Here’s a sneak peek of what we’re working on:[/h3]

Spatial puzzles require mobility!
[b]Bouncing yellow paint[/b] might help you with that:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469356/3071b322ee5930c25272c15da5a896bae61ef3d1.gif[/img]

Fear of the dark?
Fortunately, [b]glowing purple paint[/b] will enlighten your way:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45469356/6873a5667183276005e0b636ac6432f571729e7c.gif[/img]


[b]Dreampainters[/b] is a work-in-progress project. Some aspects of the game may change during the development process. We’re very excited about the journey ahead of us! For more dev updates join us by adding [b]Dreampainters[/b] to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3479080/Dreampainters/


[hr][/hr][i]Oh! You're still here!
Seems like we're already gathering some fans! If you'd like to ask some questions or share any ideas, make sure to head to [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3479080/discussions/]our Steam Discussions[/url][/b].[/i]

[i]And remember,
Your dreams may change our world!
~ Stability Games[/i]
